name: Orange Couch
source:
Yuumi and Souta have been friends for so many years now, and neither of them are planning to change that; or at the least, don't have the courage to do so. One day, a sweet little incident happens, and this stirs up a bit of awkwardness between the two; and supposedly "uninvited" feelings begin to show up. Read as Souta or as Yuumi, and find out what happens next; and just who is this new red-haired guy in class?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241108102622/https://games.renpy.org/game/orangecouch]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
尤米與索塔已經做了很多年的朋友，兩人都沒有打算改變這種關係；至少，他們都沒有這個勇氣。有一天，一件甜蜜的小插曲發生了，讓兩人之間多了幾分尷尬。那些似乎「不請自來」的感情，也開始顯露出來。你可以從索塔或尤米的視角閱讀故事，看看接下來會發生什麼；班上新來的那個紅髮男孩，又究竟是誰呢？

（摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241108102622/https://games.renpy.org/game/orangecouch]Ren'Ai檔案庫[/url]）
